cards.title: Peacock Undertow
cards.description: The focus is a petrol velvet crossed-neck top above a narrow mineral-jacquard midi skirt. A cropped espresso short-pile jacket stops at the natural waist. One amber-toned brooch closes the outer layer off centre; oxblood square-toe boots keep the hem grounded. The print is an original irregular mineral study, never a recognisable house motif.
cards.descriptionZh: 以孔雀蓝丝绒交叠领上衣和窄长矿物提花中裙为重点。咖啡色短绒外层止于自然腰，用一枚偏心琥珀感胸针收住。绛红方头靴压住裙脚；矿物纹自绘，不沿用品牌图案。

cards.title: Citrine Interval
cards.description: A citrine bias-cut dress uses a shallow draped neckline and one diagonal seam rather than bodycon gathering. A blue-grey velvet shoulder wrap ends above the elbows. Small brushed-silver ear clips and plum slingbacks provide controlled hard edges. This is the flowing member of the set; there is no cropped jacket or trouser underneath.
cards.descriptionZh: 黄晶色斜裁长裙以浅垂领和一条斜向接缝成形，不靠紧勒抽褶。蓝灰丝绒窄披层止于肘上，拉丝银耳夹与梅紫后空鞋给柔软长线留下硬边。三套中这一套专门承担流动长裙结构。

cards.title: Daylight Weight
cards.description: A cropped coral rib-knit with a sculpted high neck sits over slate wide Bermudas with a single pressed front fold. A detachable soft collar adds tactile volume without another full coat. Cream knee socks and low T-strap shoes finish a daylight silhouette. It introduces exposed lower legs and broad shorts, unlike either long-skirt design.
cards.descriptionZh: 珊瑚色短罗纹高领衫配板岩灰高腰宽百慕大裤，裤前只留一条有力度的折线。可拆软领补触感体积，不再叠一整件大衣。奶油及膝袜与低跟丁字鞋收尾，露出小腿，和另外两套长裙彻底拉开结构。

cards.title: The Borrowed Jacket
cards.description: The borrowed jacket is broad, plum-brown and visibly softened at the elbows. A pale citron rib tank hangs below its waist-length hem; a narrow charcoal wrap mini exposes one angled edge. An original blue-plum checked shirt ties at the waist as a separate piece. Oxblood loafers and plain ankle socks replace the predictable boot-and-denim ending.
cards.descriptionZh: 借来的夹克宽而呈梅棕，肘部保留柔软使用痕迹。淡酸绿罗纹背心垂出腰部衣摆，炭灰窄裹短裙露出一个斜角；独立蓝梅格衬衣系在腰间。绛红乐福与普通短袜替换千篇一律的短靴、牛仔裤结尾。

cards.title: Encore in Citron
cards.description: A dusty-plum checked mohair cardigan falls past the hip over a washed charcoal scoop-neck T-shirt. A dull citron sequined straight midi skirt supplies the only reflective field. Worn lace-up ankle boots and a thin pewter chain keep the look off duty. The skirt stops below the knee, avoiding another jeans-and-jacket formula.
cards.descriptionZh: 灰梅格纹马海毛长开衫盖过髋部，里面是水洗炭灰圆领 T 恤。暗酸绿直筒亮片中裙成为唯一反光面，旧感系带短靴与细锡色链条保持散场气质。裙长过膝，不再重复夹克配牛仔裤。

cards.title: Stairwell Flash
cards.description: A shrunken tobacco leather blouson ends above a lilac floral georgette dress with an offset hem. The floral pattern is sparse and original; it leaves quiet cloth between clusters. Opaque charcoal tights and flat buckled shoes prevent the light skirt from becoming occasionwear. A single small safety-pin pendant provides the only metal focal point.
cards.descriptionZh: 烟草色缩短皮衣停在淡紫稀疏碎花乔其裙上方，裙摆一侧短、一侧及小腿。自绘碎花之间留出空白，炭灰不透丝袜和低平搭扣鞋把轻裙拉回日常；单个小别针形坠饰作为金属重点。

cards.title: Terraces and Satin
cards.description: An ecru mesh jersey has an oxblood V-neck insert and one original diagonal panel, with no crest, sponsor or signature stripes. A silver-grey satin column skirt carries a detachable plum lace apron over one side only. Powder-blue fine socks and metallic T-strap flats keep the sports-and-evening contrast visible without adding another bow.
cards.descriptionZh: 米白网眼球衣用绛红 V 领嵌片和一块原创斜裁片定位，不加队徽、赞助商和标志条纹。银灰缎面窄长裙的一侧覆盖可拆梅紫蕾丝围片；粉蓝细袜与金属感丁字平底鞋收尾，不再堆蝴蝶结。

cards.title: Dusk Warm-up
cards.description: A moss cropped raglan track layer meets chocolate pleated Bermudas with a generous knee-length leg. A butter-coloured open-knit camisole is an independent inner garment, not a painted lining. Thin plum knee socks and narrow loafers extend the lower line. Piping is single and interrupted, not a recognisable brand stripe layout.
cards.descriptionZh: 苔绿短插肩运动外层配巧克力色宽褶及膝百慕大裤。奶油黄镂空针织吊带为独立内搭，不能画成衣服内衬；细梅紫及膝袜与窄乐福延长下半身。收边仅一条断续嵌线，不采用品牌条纹布局。

cards.title: Extra-time Bloom
cards.description: A long ice-blue mesh sports shirt is interrupted by a narrow lilac structured waist belt. Beneath it, a box-pleated skirt ends above one knee and lower on the other side; each panel remains clearly legible. An oxblood flat shoe and one plain neck ribbon concentrate the accents. The shirt has original seams rather than invented team lettering.
cards.descriptionZh: 长宽冰蓝网眼运动衫由窄淡紫结构腰束收住。下方箱褶裙一侧膝上、一侧更长，每片褶子都有清楚的结构。绛红平底鞋和一条素色细颈带集中重点；上衣用原创接缝，不编造队名文字。

cards.title: Orbital Silence
cards.description: A lesson-earned original fashion illustration inspired by Courrèges. The illustrated outfit is not yet available as wearable layers.
cards.descriptionZh: 完成 Y2K 第2关获得，参考 Courrèges 的原创时尚卡。卡面整套服装尚未制作成可穿戴图层。
